description: This file provides functions to set and get Multinet-related entity and trunk port configurations using system events. It handles setting port members, entity members, trunk port paths, and their corresponding retrieval functions with associated key formatting and buffer management.

methods.name: int ep_set_entity_vid_portMembers(int vid,int entity,char * memberPortNames[],int numPorts)
methods.description: Sets the port members for a specific entity and VLAN ID by updating system event key with member port names.

methods.name: int ep_set_entity_vidMembers(int vid,int entities[],int numEntities)
methods.description: Sets the entity members for a specific VLAN ID by updating a system event key with entity IDs.

methods.name: int ep_set_trunkPort_vid_paths(int vid,char * portName,PEntityPath paths,int numPaths)
methods.description: Sets trunk port paths for a specific VLAN ID and port name by updating the system event with path details.

methods.name: int ep_set_trunkPort_vidMembers(int vid,char * portNames[],int numPorts)
methods.description: Sets the trunk port members for a specific VLAN ID by updating system event keys with port names.

methods.name: int ep_get_entity_vid_portMembers(int vid,int entity,char * memberPortNames[],int * numPorts,char buf[],int bufSize)
methods.description: Retrieves port member names for a specific entity and VLAN ID from system event data.

methods.name: int ep_get_entity_vidMembers(int vid,int entities[],int * numEntities)
methods.description: Retrieves the entity IDs associated with a specific VLAN ID from system event data.

methods.name: int ep_get_trunkPort_vid_paths(int vid,char * portName,PEntityPath paths,int * numPaths)
methods.description: Retrieves trunk port paths for a specific VLAN ID and port name from system event data.

methods.name: int ep_get_trunkPort_vidMembers(int vid,char * portNames[],int * numPorts,char buf[],int bufSize)
methods.description: Retrieves port names of trunk port members for a specific VLAN ID from system event data.
